output.summary: A perennial bulb native to the Mediterranean region and naturalized elsewhere. A tassel of bright blue to violet sterile flowers rises above brownish-green fertile flowers. In Italy and Greece, its bulbs are eaten as a delicacy, traditionally boiled repeatedly or served pickled in olive oil.
output.edibilityNote: Bulbs are a delicacy in Italy and Greece; historically seasoned, and today often boiled repeatedly, pickled and kept in olive oil.
